issue.title: Unset fallback_controllers list warnings
issue.body:
Our setup recently started to complain about an unset `fallback_controllers` parameter.
```
[INFO] [1778687515.100459868] [arm_controller]: Received new action goal
[INFO] [1778687515.100686615] [arm_controller]: Accepted new action goal
[INFO] [1778687516.574463718] [arm_controller]: Goal reached, success!
[INFO] [1778687517.325472441] [arm_controller]: Received new action goal
[INFO] [1778687517.325594391] [arm_controller]: Accepted new action goal
[WARN] [1778687517.663535884] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[INFO] [1778687518.819410366] [arm_controller]: Goal reached, success!
[WARN] [1778687532.659037565] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687547.653311594] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687562.655851613] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687577.652542881] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687592.658599848] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687607.642737525] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687622.649339659] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687637.655355398] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687652.635913366] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687667.622851234] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687682.647852895] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
[WARN] [1778687697.628982877] [rclcpp]: Failed to get parameters: parameter 'arm_controller.fallback_controllers' is not initialized
```

**Expected behavior**
Users shouldn't have to explicitly say they aren't using any fallback controllers.
```yaml
arm_controller:
  ros__parameters:
    joints:
      - joint_1
      - joint_2
    fallback_controllers: []   # This shouldn't be required
```

**Environment:**
 - OS: Ubuntu
 - Version: Jazzy
